title: Axiom
decision: Can an AI output keep its contract?
summary: A CI-ready contract checker for structured AI outputs, with offline evaluation and value-free reports.

capabilities.label: Schema validation
capabilities.detail: Validates structured JSON outputs against operator-authored JSON Schema contracts offline.

capabilities.label: Invariant and policy checks
capabilities.detail: Applies bounded declarative rules for cross-field invariants and forbidden paths or patterns.

capabilities.label: Exact comparison
capabilities.detail: Compares a current report with a baseline using exact fractions and population compatibility.

capabilities.label: Value-free reports
capabilities.detail: Produces deterministic JSON and Markdown reports with stable findings, pointers, and metrics.

evidence.description: Committed greenhouse-inspection fixtures exercise schema, invariant, policy, retry, and baseline outcomes.
The canonical project manifest is checked offline with the vendored Five Decisions schema and existing Ajv factory.
Review guidance documents the shared engine, safety boundaries, deterministic reports, and release-readiness limits.
